verdicts.reason: A: the flavour names are stacked in reverse order with their taglines split off below, there is no spacing between them, and the delivery line is jammed into the text stack. One big can sits next to two tiny cans, which breaks the equal-trio idea, and 'light' is orphaned on its own line. It does keep logo-to-headline-to-CTA order, with the CTA at the bottom. B: the same broken text stack and loss of the trio, but worse. The CTA sits jammed in the top-left corner before the headline, the headline nearly touches the canvas edges, and the two tiny cans are stranded in the bottom-left corner beside a large dead area.
